license: User supplied Adobe Mixamo royalty-free assets; see Adobe Mixamo FAQ. Animation derivative embedded in game, original ZIP kept as build source.

policy.rest: Uploaded X Bot.fbx T pose; target original normalized 1.8m A-pose bind skeleton.
policy.rotation: World rotation delta relative to X Bot T rest, multiplied by shortest-arc target-bind-segment to source-T-segment correction; convert corrected world rotations to target parent locals.
policy.spine: Spine -> spine; cumulative Spine1+Spine2 -> chest. Chest world delta includes both source joints, rather than dropping Spine1.
policy.pelvis: Ankle-landmark calibrated fixed target pelvis baseline + (source animated Hips Y - source X Bot rest Hips Y) * sourceUnitM * target/source leg-length ratio; target X/Z stay at original rest. Baseline = target original ankle Y + scaled source rest Hips-to-ankle vertical distance.
policy.legIK: Build-time two-bone IK: source animated ankle trajectory scaled/recentered at Hips, target original thigh/shin lengths, source knee plane. Original retargeted foot world orientation is retained. Actual immutable target boot-sole geometry supplies floor clearance; unreachable goals are measured, never hidden by moving Hips or changing bones.
policy.hands: Source hand world delta with forearm segment rest correction; no finger track is emitted. Existing fixed AK grip overrides fingers at runtime.
policy.kneeCovers: Original helper rule: midpoint slerp of target upper/lower leg world rotations, converted to lower-leg local frame.
policy.heading: No rotation/root heading is removed; only horizontal Hips translation is removed. Turn rootYawDeltaRad is reported for runtime actor-heading composition.
policy.keys: Original source key times plus60Hz build-time leg IK samples and adaptive midpoint refinement where actual target FK boot clearance is below1mm; times within1microsecond merge to avoid duplicate Float32 times (FBX submicrosecond export noise). No motion key decimation or skin edits. JSON components rounded to seven decimal places (<=5e-8 component error).
policy.loaderCompatibility: Three r180 footer-length heuristic misreads three valid FBX7700 files with 202-byte footer. Build-time parser keeps all original FBX node bytes + terminal null record and supplies 160 ignored footer bytes; original ZIP/FBX are unchanged.
policy.classification: Source = uploaded Adobe Mixamo files/user license statement; original = soldier24 skeleton,54-joint skin and fixed finger assets; tuning = segment frame correspondence/Spine chain collapse.
